hook: New to GoMining? Here is what the referral page lists.

scenes.narration: GoMining's referral page lists bonuses a referred friend can get. Terms can change, so check them yourself.
They include a five percent bonus on the first miner, up to twenty-five terahash, and a month of Platinum Plus.
These are promotions, not promises. Eligibility and regional availability apply.

cta: Have you checked the terms? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: GoMining Referral Bonuses: What a New User Can Get
